value.summary: The change adds a `summarise` module with `shorten` and `first_sentence` helpers for truncating model-authored text, fixes the GitHub App environment variable names in `docker-compose.yml` to match what `AppAuth::from_env` actually reads, mounts `.tinysweeper.toml` into the container, and adds an opt-in kernel-bypass overlay for MongoDB on Linux 6.19+. The `summarise` tests pin the key behaviours including the multibyte-panic case that motivated the character-boundary rewrite. No defects found; safe to merge.
